about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saints Peter and Paul, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, by the intercession of Your Apostles, defend from all harm those whom You have filled with heavenly food. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
